full_judgment: 8. Mr. Md. Latifur Rahman, the learned Counsel appearing for the contesting respondent Nos. 1 and 2 agitates that the finding of facts arrived at by the lower appellate court cannot be disturbed by the High Court Division in second appeal. This argument of the learned Counsel is not tenable as the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court has held that while exercising its limited jurisdiction under section 100 of the Code of. Civil. Procedure, "The High Court can give a finding which has not been given by the lower appellate court on the evidence on record: interference on that ground will be quite lawful". Erfan Ali Vs. Joinal Abedin Mia . 1983 B.L.D (AD) 342, para 14. Further the Appellate Division has held: "The appellate court reversed the finding of facts on evidence but once it is shown that such reversal has been made without taking notice of the documentary evidence the second appellate court may reassess the evidence and come to its own finding on this .point". Sk. Abdul Latif Vs. Abdul Malek Kazi ; 1984 B.L.D. (AD) 15, para 8.
